_about: P0 / S4b scenes (docs/P0_S4B.md). Each scene is built as a real engine state (class, skills, arrival, the narrator's report of who is there) by tools/p0/lib/s4b.mjs; bands and HP are then set as written here. A0 reads that state; the LLM arms see the catalog rendered from it plus features, places and RECENT, which only this file knows. Opponent refs become ids mon.<ref> (creatures) or npc.<ref> (people).

burrow_fight.arrive: I climb down into the old barkscorpion burrow below the dry riverbed.
burrow_fight.prose: Three barkscorpions burst out of the sand around the burrow floor.
burrow_fight.where: the old barkscorpion burrow below the dry riverbed

features.text: a cracked stone floor over a hollow
a narrow hole in the burrow wall, leading deeper
a frayed rope ladder hanging down the entrance shaft
a heap of loose rubble by the tunnel mouth

burrow_fight.recent: Barkscorpion C skitters along the wall; its stinger grazes Alaric's shoulder before it pulls back into the dark. Barkscorpion B drags itself toward the hole in the wall, one leg crushed. Barkscorpion A clacks its pincers right in front of him.

burrow_dry.arrive: I climb down into the old barkscorpion burrow below the dry riverbed.
burrow_dry.prose: Two dry-brown barkscorpions block the tunnel.

features.text: a frayed rope ladder hanging down the entrance shaft
a heap of loose rubble by the tunnel mouth

burrow_dry.recent: Two dry-brown barkscorpions block the tunnel. The nearer one snaps at Alaric; the other waits by the rubble.

burrow_single.where: the old barkscorpion burrow below the dry riverbed

burrow_single.recent: A lone barkscorpion rears up in front of Alaric, its tail curled over the cracked floor.

wolf_fight.arrive: I climb the pine trail toward the ridge.
wolf_fight.prose: Wolves come out of the trees.
wolf_fight.where: the pine trail below the ridge

features.text: a dead pine leaning over the trail

places.name: Millbrook, the village down the trail

wolf_fight.recent: The dire wolf circles at the treeline while Grey Wolf A snaps at Alaric's boots. Grey Wolf B limps behind with an arrow in its flank.

bandit_fight.arrive: I walk to the crossroads south of Redmarch.
bandit_fight.prose: Two bandits jump out at the crossroads; Brede the salt merchant stumbles back from his cart.

features.text: a lantern hanging on a rope from a post

bandit_fight.recent: Bandit B, blood on his sleeve, has just cut Brede's purse strings and backs off grinning. Bandit A raises his club at Alaric.

burrow_after.arrive: I climb down into the old barkscorpion burrow below the dry riverbed.
burrow_after.where: the old barkscorpion burrow below the dry riverbed

features.text: a cracked stone floor over a hollow
a narrow hole in the burrow wall, leading deeper
a heap of loose rubble by the tunnel mouth

burrow_after.recent: Barkscorpion A lies still at Alaric's feet. The other two scuttled through the hole in the wall, leaving drag marks in the dust.

town.arrive: I walk into the Redmarch market.
town.prose: Hesta the spice merchant nods at Alaric from her stall.

features.text: a cold iron brazier by the stall
a stuck oak door to a storeroom

town.recent: Hesta sorts saffron into little paper cones and nods at Alaric. Earlier a scar-faced thug shoved past him and disappeared into the crowd.
